root_cause: Single-shot generation with no execution feedback: unmatched string literals, wrong column sets and one-sided relation filters go unchecked
what: Add an execute-and-repair loop (draft, run it, and on error/empty result send the model the actual stored values and relation-direction diagnostics for one corrective call), tighten the system prompt with general value-matching/column-selection/symmetry rules, and raise max_tokens so the final SQL block is not truncated.

root_cause: No execution feedback loop: literal/format mismatches and empty results are never detected or repaired
what: Add a draft-then-verify control loop: execute the first SQL, and if it errors or returns 0 rows spend the second policy call on a repair prompt that includes the error/empty-result signal plus sampled distinct values of the columns used in string predicates (probing case-insensitive equality, LIKE variants and trimmed literals). Also add generic Spider-style guidance to select all columns of the main entity for 'which X / details' questions. This targets value-formatting failures (sp0362, sp0536, sp0610), the hidden empty-result failure (sp0894) and the column-scope failure (sp0755).
decision: Both candidates reach the same evolve score (90.0) with one regression each, but s2 does it at 882 vs 1237 mean tokens and without touching config/max_tokens, so it is the cheaper and less invasive change; its draft-execute-repair loop with sampled stored values is a general mechanism rather than task-specific tuning.

root_cause: Executable-but-wrong results go unchecked: one-to-many join duplicates and wrong projection width never trigger the repair loop
what: solve.py now also treats duplicated result rows as a defect signal and spends the second policy call on a focused DISTINCT/projection review (keeping the existing error/empty-result repair path); system_prompt.md adds explicit rules to use SELECT DISTINCT when joining one-to-many tables for existence-style filters and to return all columns of every joined table for entity-level 'which X' questions.

root_cause: No structural self-check: join fan-out produces duplicate rows and 'which entities' questions get name-only projections instead of full joined records
what: Add a second repair trigger for queries that execute fine but return duplicate result rows (join fan-out): sample the DB to show whether duplicates are stored or join-induced, and prompt a DISTINCT-vs-join-key fix. Also strengthen the projection rule in the system prompt so entity-level questions over joined tables select all columns of the joined tables (Spider gold convention) rather than just names.

root_cause: Executable-but-wrong output shape: join fan-out duplicates and name-only projections for entity questions never trigger any check
what: Add a deterministic projection/duplicate review path in solve.py: when the draft executes fine but returns exact duplicate rows (join fan-out) or is an entity-style question ('which/what are the <entities>') projected to only 1-2 columns while its joins could expose more, spend the second policy call on a focused review that lists the actual column inventory of every joined table plus the duplicate-row evidence, and instructs DISTINCT vs. stored-duplicates reasoning and SELECT * / T1.* width per Spider convention. Accept the revision only if it still executes and returns rows; keep the existing error/empty-result repair untouched.

root_cause: Projection width is guessed from question wording, so 'which entities' questions get name-only SELECTs where gold returns the full joined row set
what: Replace the vague 'return all columns of the main table' rule with a concrete projection-width policy: for entity-listing questions (Which/What/List/Show/Find + plural entity noun) that do not enumerate attributes, select every column of every joined table in FROM order (T1.*, T2.*), and only narrow to named attributes when the question explicitly lists them; superlative/count/rank questions keep the minimal asked-for projection. This targets sp0755 (gold = country.* + countrylanguage.*) without touching literal matching or the repair loop.
gate: screen: Task specialization / evolve-set overfitting: the description explicitly targets sp0755 and states the gold projection (country.* + countrylanguage.*), and the prompt rule is written around that exact case, including the literal example `SELECT T1.*, T2.* FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T
